biography: Stanley Wessler's story begins amidst the vibrant chaos of São Paulo, Brazil. Born into a family where football reigned supreme, Stanley's heart instead throbbed for the roar of engines. His first taste of speed came not on a track, but tearing through the city streets on his beat-up BMX bike, a skill he honed delivering groceries for his family's small shop. It wasn't until his late teens, after sneaking into a local Copa Fusca race, that he knew racing was his destiny. The raw, unfiltered energy of the air-cooled engines ignited something within him. Scrounging together savings and with the support of a local mechanic who saw his raw talent, Stanley entered the Copa Fusca circuit. His aggressive, no-holds-barred style quickly made him a fan favorite. Today, Stanley is making waves in the Copa Fusca, proving he's a force to be reckoned with, one aggressively overtaken corner at a time. He dreams of one day stepping into a Stock Car Brasil machine.
drivingStyle: Stanley's driving is a reflection of his personality: aggressive and relentless. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to take risks, often pushing the limits of his car and tires. While his raw speed is undeniable, he is still learning the nuances of tire management and race strategy. In high-pressure situations, he tends to overdrive the car, sometimes resulting in costly mistakes, but his natural talent and fearless approach often compensate for his lack of experience. He attacks every corner like it's the last, making him both exciting and unpredictable to watch.

rivalries.name: Ricardo 'The Professor' Albuquerque
rivalries.reason: A veteran of the Copa Fusca, Ricardo represents the old guard. Stanley's aggressive style clashes with Ricardo's calculated approach, leading to numerous on-track clashes and heated words off-track.

rivalries.name: Isabela 'Ice' Ferreira
rivalries.reason: Isabela is a rising star known for her cool and collected demeanor. Stanley sees her as his direct competition and is constantly trying to prove himself better. Their rivalry is fueled by mutual respect and a desire to be the best.

rivalries.name: João 'Lucky' Santana
rivalries.reason: João is seen as a 'pay driver' who bought his way into the sport. Stanley believes João doesn't deserve his spot and is determined to show him up on the track, often resulting in dangerous and controversial overtakes.

quirks: Always wears the same faded Senna t-shirt under his race suit.
Listens to the same vintage samba track before every race.
Taps the roof of his car three times before the formation lap.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the Interlagos round of the Copa Fusca in 2023, after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying penalty. He carved his way through the field with a series of daring overtakes, showcasing his raw talent and unwavering determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the Cascavel race in 2022, handing the victory to his rival, Ricardo Albuquerque. The incident cost him valuable championship points and a severe blow to his confidence.
